title: Ijaarsitoota Utubaawwan Olka’oo
intro: Diigama magaalaa durii ulfina qabeessa, utubaawwan ishee ol kaʼoon amma kufanii jiran dura dhaabbatta. Qilleensi kun yaadannoo ummata jabaa yeroo tokko biyyoota kana bulchaa turee baattee daandii duwwaa keessaa iyye. Eenyu turan?
clues: Uummata humnaa fi ogummaa hangana hin jedhamne, gamoo gurguddaa fi qaroomina keenya guddateen beekamnu turre.
Biyya cirrachaa fi tulluu dhagaa qabu keessa kan jiraannu siʼa taʼu, namni nu moʼuu akka hin dandeenye ni amanna turre.
Ergamaan tokko fira keenya keessaa nutti dhufee, Rabbiin tokkicha gabbaruuf nu waame, nuti garuu isa dinnee itti qoosne.
'Eenyutu nu caala?' of tuulummaa fi waaqeffannaa waaqa tolfamaas itti fufne.
Rabbiin qilleensi hamaa halkan torbaa fi guyyaa saddeet bubbee waan hunda balleessee nutti erge.
Nuti ummata 'Ad, ijaartoota Iram waan turreef, hireen keenya warra booda dhufan hundaaf akeekkachiisa ta'e.

trial.label: Adabbiin isaan irratti ergame maal ture?

location.label: Magaalaan isaanii seeraan beekamtu kun maali?

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
